title: Assessment of Use of Non-mRNA COVID-19 Vaccines in Wider Population
what_it_is: Assessment of Use of Non-mRNA COVID-19 Vaccines in Wider Population

sections.label: Sinovac booster for ineligible persons
sections.summary: Medically ineligible persons aged 18 and above can receive Sinovac-CoronaVac as a booster under the National Vaccination Programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Persons who are medically ineligible to receive the mRNA vaccine and aged 18 and above, can receive Sinovac-CoronaVac vaccine under the National Vaccination Programme (NVP) as a booster vaccine.

sections.label: Sinovac after mRNA programme
sections.summary: MOH introduced the Sinovac after mRNA programme outside the NVP for individuals aged 12 to 17 medically ineligible for Pfizer-BioNTech/Comirnaty.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: MOH has, therefore, also separately introduced a dedicated public health programme – Sinovac after mRNA (SAM) – outside of the NVP, to offer the Sinovac-CoronaVac vaccine to individuals aged 12 to 17 who are medically ineligible for the Pfizer-BioNTech/Comirnaty COVID-19 vaccine, to afford them some level of protection against COVID-19 while closely monitoring their safety.

sections.label: Novavax vaccine HSA assessment
sections.summary: HSA assessed the Novavax COVID-19 vaccine as safe and effective for persons aged 18 and above and issued interim authorisation in February 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Novavax COVID-19 vaccine has been assessed by HSA to be safe and effective for persons aged 18 and above, with two doses demonstrating a vaccine efficacy of 90% against symptomatic infection and 100% against severe disease with the wildtype SARS-CoV2 and the Alpha variant, with no significant safety concerns.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Therefore, in February 2022, HSA issued its PSAR interim authorisation letter to Novavax for its COVID-19 vaccine.

sections.label: Expert Committee recommends Novavax under NVP
sections.summary: The Expert Committee for COVID-19 Vaccination recommended the Novavax vaccine under the NVP for primary and booster vaccination in individuals aged 18 and older.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Expert Committee for COVID-19 Vaccination (EC19V) has also reviewed data on the vaccine’s safety and efficacy and has recommended the use of the Novavax COVID-19 vaccine under the NVP for primary and booster vaccination in individuals aged 18 and older.

sections.label: Daily cases and week-on-week increase
sections.summary: Daily cases are 10,000 or more, and the week-on-week increase is about 1.5.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Right now, we are getting 10,000 or more cases on a daily basis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Right now, the week-on-week increase is about 1.5.

sections.label: Beds occupied at 10,000 cases
sections.summary: As of last night, 23 beds were occupied even at 10,000 cases a day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Today, even at 10,000 cases a day, as of last night, it was 23 beds occupied.

sections.label: Quick Test Centre ART records
sections.summary: Individuals can go to Quick Test Centres for a supervised ART test, and a positive result is ingested into their HealthHub record within 30 minutes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: So, it is the operational side that is posing a challenge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We are going to allow individuals to come to the Quick Test Centres (QTCs), go through a supervised ART test and, within 30 minutes, we can ingest their infection record, if they are tested positive, into their HealthHub record.

sections.label: Booking Quick Test Centre appointments
sections.summary: Starting with about a quarter of them, people can book a Quick Test Centre appointment, take an ART test, and have a positive result ingested into HealthHub.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We will start with about a quarter of them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: So, by the end of today, you will be able to book an appointment with the QTCs and go through an ART test and then ingest the record, if you are positive, into your HealthHub.
